renderer_issues.description: All three assigned rendered pages report successful parsing and preserve canonical line alignment; no mechanical rendering defect was observed.

Several substitutions assert semantics not established by these bodies: item frequency/weight/mask, Pokémon override, SD penalty, stock/coin mappings, hit-interaction disabling, match-in-progress, damage ratio, end-graphic type, player start damage, Zako score, and result-data identity. These remain hypotheses, not verified corrections.

`fn_8016B5B0` rendered as `gm_GetJoystickCountScale` is misleadingly specific: the visible implementation counts non-NA player slots, not joystick devices, and also branches on mode and match outcome.

`gm_8016B41C` rendered as `gm_IsCurrentGameMode1P` should not be assumed equivalent to the separately delegated `gm_IsCurrently1PMode`; this shard establishes only the former's explicit membership list.

Assigned rendered pages preserve canonical line alignment and control flow and report zero parse errors. Several substitutions convey semantics not independently established by these bodies, including gm_HandlePlayerDefeat, gm_CalculateMatchBonuses, and gm_GetPlayerRank; they remain hypotheses, not confirmed corrections.

The renderer reports a name collision for gm_801A4BA8 -> gm_GetFrameCount and leaves the canonical symbol unchanged. No line-alignment or parse failure was observed in the three assigned rendered pages.
Aliases such as gm_GetPlayerScore, gm_GetFighterKOs, and gm_GetClassicData imply semantics not established by these local bodies alone. They remain hypotheses, not verified corrections.

The rendered view reports a name collision: fn_8016E124 and fn_80169C54 both propose gm_PreloadKirbyCopyAbilityResources and remain canonical in the view. They must not be conflated; the visible function takes no arguments, while the visible call to the other helper supplies character and costume.

evidence.why: Shows the distinct character/costume helper call.
